## Independent reviewer reproduction

Run from the repository root:

```powershell
py -3 -m unittest discover -s tests/governance -p "test_*.py" -v
git diff --check
git status --short
Get-FileHash -Algorithm SHA256 -LiteralPath '.\docs\build\SOURCE_MANIFEST.md'
```

Pass means all 7 governance tests report `ok`, the suite exits `0`, `git diff --check` exits `0`, only the exact Prompt 01 paths listed above are changed, and the manifest hash is `4ce13c6d0fa6eb7d99f4e7023a7c48669bb57407827dc83f661f8ab6eccbb436`.
